ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (28) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Зло» (zlo, 'evil') is kept as 'evil' throughout, including where the website draft had softened it to 'harm'; generic «человек» (chelovek, 'person, man') takes 'he/his'. The attributions follow the print: «Индийские Ману» (Indiyskiye Manu, literally 'Indian Manu', plural adjective) is rendered 'Indian Manu', and «Индийский Курал» (Indiyskiy Kural) 'Indian Kural', as elsewhere in the book.
